title: local_filter
description: Flexible local listing matching rules evaluated by application code. Animal categories are opt-in: an omitted or false *_allowed value excludes that category.

date_window_match.description: How a configured date window is applied to a sit.

start_date_on_or_after.description: Earliest inclusive sit start date, including its year.

end_date_on_or_before.description: Latest inclusive sit end date, including its year.

dogs_allowed.description: Whether listings containing dogs can match.

cats_allowed.description: Whether listings containing cats can match.

fish_allowed.description: Whether listings containing fish can match.

birds_allowed.description: Whether listings containing birds can match.

rabbits_guinea_pigs_allowed.description: Whether listings containing rabbits or guinea pigs can match.

chickens_ducks_geese_allowed.description: Whether listings containing chickens, ducks, or geese can match.

farm_animals_allowed.description: Whether listings containing farm animals can match.

horses_allowed.description: Whether listings containing horses can match.

reptiles_allowed.description: Whether listings containing reptiles can match.

other_pets_allowed.description: Whether listings containing unclassified pets can match.

no_pets_allowed.description: Whether sits explicitly marked as having no pets can match.

allowed_house_types.description: House types allowed by the filter.

excluded_house_types.description: House types excluded by the filter.

include_keywords.description: Keywords that should appear in listing text.

exclude_keywords.description: Keywords that should not appear in listing text.
